superseded_native_package.reason: Built before the actual a11y correction; never published. Final package is deployment-202-v2.

network_verifier: Initial raw firewall-output hash comparison rejected generated timestamps. A separate read-only diagnostic identified them; final verification substitutes only comment timestamps and exactly reconstructs original baseline hashes. All policy/rule/other bytes must still match. Original verifier and failed operation are retained.

retained_failures.reason: Packaging process was still running; archive checksum was not yet created. Guard stopped before connecting to or writing on server. Successful upload occurred only after packaging completion.

Download activation had not returned its receipt yet. Missing dependency stopped before candidate start, service changes or static directory swaps. Original activation-v1 credential snapshot directory retained privately; no network configuration changed.

operations.correction: Wait for successful dependent operations; require published download receipt before creating a fresh activation-v2 state. Preserve executed v2 script and original state; replay separate v3.

qa.first_live_attempt: No model/task/dataset write reached. An actual safe task GET unexpectedly returned HTML; original status was not retained by the older helper, so no precise cause is inferred. Separate read-only exact-path replay returns200 JSON and original charge38898. New driver records status/type on failure and retries only safe GET once on actual network/502/503/504, never auth callbacks or writes.
qa.first_inner_attempt: Setup completed its full200 bytes and SHA; the subsequent transport hit its30-second idle timeout. Retain original failed receipt, retry separately with90-second bounded reads after public transfer completes.

scope: All original failures and actual partial successes are retained separately from final passing evidence; driver/fixture fixes do not imply product changes or network modifications.

later_live_diagnosis.v2: Native HTML was rejected; earlier helper reported a generic connection error. Original failed receipt retained.
later_live_diagnosis.v3: Dataset import correctly deduplicated existing CSV; the driver incorrectly waited for a newly invented name. Later drivers use the actual returned identity/name.
later_live_diagnosis.v4: Original native IPC captured the precise Download checksum mismatch without replacing product responses.
later_live_diagnosis.v5: An added diagnostic clone observer used unsupported dynamic import in the Electron VM. This diagnostic failed; its intermediate text is not passing qualification.
later_live_diagnosis.v6: Actual original public native response was367bytes longer than the Web HTML; identical prefix/suffix isolate an injected Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon before closing body. CSV/JSON original bytes match. Original integrity guard correctly rejected changed HTML.
later_live_diagnosis.correction: Application-only no-transform for downloaded/hash-bound HTML, including same-class downloads. No server networking or checksum guard changes; final original native bytes must match Web.
